scientific_scope: model-internal prospectively frozen visitor RNG cohort, exploratory transfer of a posthoc-discovered beta/Gamma_seed map; NOT independent field systems, universal evolutionary mechanism or registered publication primary
root_question: At fixed initial monomorphic expressed genotype state, does the collective investment shift that raises/lower total viable seeds translate to higher/lower unconditional occupancy at H=80, under previously unexposed stochastic visitor histories?

conditions.prior_use_assertion: dedicated seed range selected before future runs; do not mix with earlier 261106/371108/401109/411109/421109 cohorts
conditions.visitor_source: same four fixed matching optima 0.15/0.35/0.55/0.75 with breadth 0.18/effectiveness 1 at year0; Model3 make_history separation with random loss/arrivals over 80 reproductive years, visitor arrival distance0
conditions.initial_census_policy: N0=K monomorphic diploid exact whole individual genotypes; K8 vs K48 contrasts bundle starting N and future capacity, not an isolated carrying-capacity effect

outcome_contract.primary_endpoint: unconditional N80>0 within each seed x K x assurance x gate x shift cell
outcome_contract.estimand: paired across 64 independently generated visitor histories Delta=mean(occupancy under +0.05 investment - occupancy under -0.05 investment) per K, assurance, gate at H=80; Gamma_persist=Delta/0.10
outcome_contract.uncertainty: paired 1999 percentile bootstrap draws resampling entire visitor history seeds; seed 61021999; no false history replication from demographic paths
outcome_contract.decision: positive if bootstrap CI lower > +0.05 probability points, negative if upper < -0.05, practically_equivalent if both CI limits inside [-0.05,+0.05], otherwise inconclusive
outcome_contract.sample_stop: exactly 64 histories, no significance-based stopping, failed or extinct paths retained
outcome_contract.prediction_at_source_visitor_state: K48 and assurance0.35 beta positive/Gamma_seed positive; K48 and assurance0.65 beta negative/Gamma_seed positive; K8 sign differences explicitly treated as different finite-N selection estimands
outcome_contract.claim_rule: beta vs Gamma_persist conflict only if independent-cohort occupancy direction resolves and is opposite to the same-cell beta; if unresolved, no concordance claim; beta source initial state under 4 fixed visitors is not a beta for all later variable visitor trajectories
outcome_contract.zero_monomorphic_variation_note: monomorphic genotypes and zero mutation make allele evolution impossible; this is a collective phenotype/genotype initial-shift persistence intervention, NOT an evolution-enabled vs frozen evolutionary-suicide experiment
design_gates: full source JSON original and future output hashes
new visitor cohort and biological setting frozen before any run
paired visitor history ID and random streams
no nonzero mutant alleles introduced except declared ±0.05 initial shift
no permanent changes to canonical biology

interpretation_exclusions: not K-only causal effect because N0=K
no gene load or deleterious variants
cannot treat independent visitor draws from one simulator as independent ecological systems
